title: Dualizing one affine comparison coordinate square
statement: Let i:Z \to Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open of Y, n a natural number, E,Q module sheaves on Z, and tau:E \to Q. Suppose tau restricted to O=i^{-1}U has an affine coordinate square IsAffineSelfTorChartMap with the normalized algebraic comparison [new-n1-self-tor-compatible-affine-maps, new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. For any open V of Z put W=V intersect O, and let F=T_U.op followed by duality, restriction to V, and over-site restriction to W [def-pur-sheaf-hom, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. There are isomorphisms a from dual(Q)|_V over W to F(target(c_U).op), and b from F(source(c_U).op) to dual(E)|_V over W, such that dualMap(tau)|_V over W equals a followed by F(c_U.op) followed by b. This statement has no global existence assertion and no derived or regularity hypothesis.

source.place: Section 17.22, internal Hom defined by local module morphisms; precomposition and scalar multiplication on smaller opens. Steps 4 of new-r4-self-tor-conormal-dual-chart-iso are formalized sectionwise.

proof.text: A local map on O acts on dual sections over an open D of V contained in V intersect O by precomposing with its restriction to the image of D in Z. The image lies in O. This defines chartRestrictedDualMap. Linearity and naturality are checked on each smaller-open component.

Check componentwise that this construction preserves identities, reverses composition, and agrees with the restricted dualMap of a global map. Apply it to an isomorphism and its inverse to construct chartRestrictedDualIso and prove the two inverse laws.

Unpack the source and target coordinates in the hypothesis. Apply the operation to their coordinate-square equation. The target coordinate produces a, the source coordinate produces b, and the middle map is exactly F(c_U.op). Associativity gives the displayed equation.

theorem selfTor_affine_chart_square_dualization
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ)
    (E Q : Z.Modules) (τ : E ⟶ Q)
    (hτ : IsAffineSelfTorChartMap i U n E Q (τ.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))
    (V : Z.Opens) :
    let W := V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    let F := T.op ⋙ Scheme.Modules.dualFunctor Z ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ W
    let c := selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    ∃ (a : (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.dual Q)).over W) ≅ F.obj (op _))
      (b : F.obj (op _) ≅ (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.dual E)).over W)),
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (Scheme.Modules.dualMap τ)).over W =
        a.hom ≫ F.map c.op ≫ b.hom
